text:
For hotel conversions in the **Caribbean and Latin America**, the commonly considered soft-brand and collection options include:

| Parent company | Soft-brand / collection options | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upscale independent hotels and resorts; particularly relevant for distinctive full-service and all-inclusive properties. Marriott expressly positions these three as operating platforms for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**, **Outset Collection by Hilton** | LXR for luxury; Curio for upper-upscale/luxury full-service; Tapestry and Outset for upscale boutique conversions. Curio and Tapestry already have conversion activity in CALA; Outset is the newer, more flexible conversion option. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/launch-of-outset-collection-by-hilton?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Unscripted by Hyatt** | Unbound for story-driven luxury; Destination for destination resorts and residences; JdV for neighborhood-oriented boutiques; Unscripted for lighter-touch upscale conversions. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection**, plus conversion-oriented **voco**; **Noted Collection** as an emerging option | Vignette is the principal luxury soft brand and already has a property in Peru. voco provides somewhat more branding but remains conversion-friendly. Noted targets upscale and upper-upscale independent hotels, although its initial rollout is concentrated outside CALA. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Emblems for highly selective luxury assets; MGallery for upper-upscale/luxury boutique hotels; Handwritten for more approachable, conversion-friendly independent properties. Accor has an established South American platform. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/franchising-accor-luxury-lifestyle-strategy?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**, **Dolce Hotels and Resorts**, and—in suitable value-oriented markets—**Dazzler Select** | Registry for luxury; Trademark for upper-midscale/upscale independent hotels; Dolce for resorts, conference and destination properties. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, **Radisson Individuals** | Ascend for upscale historic, boutique and resort properties; Radisson Individuals for larger or full-service upper-upscale hotels. Choice has historically offered Ascend in the Caribbean. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/news/choice-hotels-relaunches-radisson-individuals-as-part-of-its-portfolio-of-brands-MCGUOTHASSNZBF5OUH7E7UATMTII?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Distinctive and Crafted**, **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection** | Often considered where preserving the independent name and operating style is especially important, or where a lighter affiliation structure is preferred. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/bwpremier?utm_source=openai)) |

### Practical first-round shortlist

For most competitive processes, owners typically begin with:

- **Luxury resort:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Unbound, Vignette, MGallery/Emblems, Registry or WorldHotels Luxury.
- **Upper-upscale full-service resort:** Autograph, Curio, Destination by Hyatt, Tribute Portfolio or MGallery.
- **Upscale boutique or city hotel:** Tapestry, Outset, JdV, Unscripted, Handwritten, Trademark, Ascend or BW Premier Collection.
- **All-inclusive conversion:** Marriott’s collection brands and Curio are particularly worth testing because both systems have demonstrated all-inclusive applications in the region. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-and-fuerte-group-hotels-to-debut-amare-cancun-adults-only-all-inclusive-resort?utm_source=openai))

A “soft brand” still does **not** mean standards-free. The decisive comparison is usually the required renovation/PIP, ability to retain the existing name and design, F&B and amenity requirements, franchise versus management availability, loyalty contribution, central-system fees, territorial protection, all-inclusive capability and any residences component. Brand availability can also vary materially by country, destination and existing territorial restrictions.
